svg.aria-label: Use Null. Control+Space: Show or hide the box Enter: Send a message, or choose a list entry Esc: Close a picker, cancel sign-in, or hide the box Ctrl+C: Stop the reply; when idle, quit and close the conversation ↑: Recall the last prompt in an empty field Drag: Move the box; click away hides it The arrow pulses while the agent works and turns amber when it asks. The transcript grows to about ten lines, then scrolls. Hiding the box does not stop a reply.
